text: Handle a git task, but the object and action are unspecified (scenario 1)
label_rationale: Only the git domain is named and both the object and the action are unspecified, so at least two mutually incompatible readings stay live: (1) inspect the current working-tree and staging status -> git.status; (2) record the staged changes as a commit -> git.commit. The readings require different arguments and nothing in the query rules either one out, so this is interpretation ambiguity rather than a plain missing value: the reason is ambiguous, and the tool behind each reading is recorded in the relevant set.
